description: Fuaran conformance-law vector corpus. SELF-ENUMERATED: these vectors are deliberately not indexed by the corpus root manifest.json, which indexes the canonical wire-format codec families only — the merge-conformance/ and devtools-relay/ precedent. A `law-vectors` file carries the (input, expected) pairs one Fuaran.Core conformance law family draws from a declared seed, computed by calling the pinned kit, so a host that is not the reference can run the same family over the same sample. A family that takes the host's own implementation as an argument (a PARITY family) carries the REFERENCE ANSWERS the host is compared against, and declares its sample generator in its own description, since the family itself has no sample to draw. These are BEHAVIOUR vectors, not byte-parity fixtures: a host asserts the verdicts and derived values, not the framing of this file.

families.description: The invocable-capability contract: arg validation, the capture-replay key, the declaration codec round-trip, and id-stable registry enumeration.

The reference evaluator's answers over AUTHORED (source, pipeline) pairs, one named case per evaluator feature (filters, group-bys, derives, the apply functions, sorts, joins, windows, pivot and unpivot, union, a refusal), in transformLaws' vector shape: a host round-trips both inputs through its codec, evaluates, and compares the result table byte for byte, or refuses where the reference refused. Authored inputs rather than a seeded draw, so the file declares no seed, iterations or kitVersion; `producer.commit` is the commit that emitted it (Phase 1938, which moved the cases here from a host's own tests, where they had hand-recorded answers and no producer).

The exact decimal (fuaran-core Phase 276) — its canonical text, numeric order, exact sum and refusals, with the nearest-double reading and the decimal column's codec and aggregates — over AUTHORED inputs rather than a seeded draw, which is why the file declares no seed or iterations and this row carries neither.

The schema field (fuaran-core Phase 427): a column's name and type, and the metadata that says what it means (an optional unit in the canonical text of the unit algebra, a label, a description, and string extension members a host preserves verbatim) over AUTHORED inputs, so the file declares no seed or iterations: the schema entry's canonical bytes, its decode and canonical re-encoding, and the refusals.

The dataframe-transform parity contract: for each drawn (source, pipeline), the canonical wire encoding of the table the reference evaluator produced — or the bare verdict that it refused the pipeline. A host with its own evaluator decodes both halves with its existing dataframe codec, evaluates, and compares. Exported as the reference's ANSWERS rather than as the law's verdict, which is why this family was previously listed as not exported: run over the reference itself the law certifies only the reference's self-consistency, whereas its answers are exactly what a host cannot obtain without the reference.
